reveal_schedule.topic: All Relic and Blessing Tier Passives

choices.name: Endless Harvest
choices.description: Auto-banks gathering resources. 10% chance to upgrade fish/ore/logs to next tier (uses Polishing perk tables). Auto-follow fishing spots. Permanent stamina while mining. Active time sprite while excavating. Reduced tree felling rate with auto-resume.
clarifications: Uses same tables as Polishing perk for resource upgrades

choices.name: Survivalist
choices.description: Doubles resources gathered (NO extra XP). Survivalist's Bag (150 storage x3 types). Best tools: Pickaxe of the Faithful, Harpoon of the Pious, Hatchet of Devotion. Rockertunities deal double damage and give ore immediately. Time sprite focus doubled. 50% chance auto-restore artefacts with full restoration XP.
clarifications: XP is NOT awarded for extra yields from this relic
Tools named: Pickaxe of the Faithful, Harpoon of the Pious, Hatchet of Devotion

choices.name: Golden Touch
choices.description: Goldenhawk boots (T60 hybrid, passive Agility XP). Goldenhawk feathers from Agility/Thieving → Prayer XP or alch. Feathers CANNOT be offered to altars, bonfires, or Ectofuntus. Double Agility course XP, coins on completion, no failures. Guaranteed pickpocket success, triple noted loot. Stalls never deplete, safes no cooldown. Coins from Thieving x100. Chests/safes drop herbs/potions to bank.
clarifications: Feathers cannot be offered to altars, bonfires, or Ectofuntus

passives: Slayer points and Reaper points x5
Heart of Gielinor, Menaphos, Farming reputation x4

choices.name: Animal Wrangler
choices.description: Auto-bank fish and Hunter loot. 2% chance random farm animal from Hunter/Fishing (toggle Manor/Anachronia). 33% chance herb/herb seed/tree seed/fruit tree seed → bank. Farm animals 100% stats, never hungry. Hunter 100% catch chance. Buyers pay max beans. Hunter loot and marks x5. Traps attract faster. No bait needed for Fishing. +1 fish per catch. Big Game Hunter no bait, 2x slower detection. Spirit moths 10x charms. Farm animals 20x more common.
clarifications: Havenhythe Big Game Hunter also affected by no-bait and slower detection

choices.name: Superheated
choices.description: Toggle auto-burn logs while WC regardless of FM level. Toggle auto-cook fish while Fishing regardless of Cooking level. Bonfire rate 0.6s/log. 1 incense stick = max potency 60 min. Blessed fire spirits (more frequent, spawn while Smithing). Smelting: double bars, 3% chance for 50 bars. Smelt cap increased to 60. Smithing completion gives invention materials. Constant max heat, triple base-progress per strike. Ceremonial swords: 5x XP + 50 bars. Burial sets XP x3.

choices.name: Divine Druid
choices.description: Thera's Summoning pouch (stores grimy herbs + charms, replaces spirit shards/pouches, teleport to any large obelisk). Toggle: grimy herbs → unfinished potions on cleaning. Grimy herbs/charms from Mining/Fishing/WC/Divination/Archaeology. Clean all grimy herbs at once. 75% chance to save secondary ingredients. Charm drop rate x5. Summoning familiars boost skills 3x. 50% chance extra pouch → bank. Always get 10 scrolls → bank. Always enriched memories. Half energy for conversion/crafting. 10% chance for porter/divine charge on conversion. Memory strands x10. Chronicle fragments: 2x Hunter XP. All Meilyr recipes unlocked.

passives: 10% chance for 8 common/uncommon invention materials from monsters
Dungeoneering tokens x3 (from DG and Elite Dungeons)

choices.name: Nature's Network
choices.description: Fairy mushroom: unlimited teleports to spirit trees, fairy rings, farming patches in unlocked regions. Crops instantly grow to full, produce auto-noted. 1 herb seed = 10 planted. Seeds grow instantly to maturity (no disease). All patches auto-ultracompost. 25% chance to save seeds when sowing.

choices.name: Assassin's Insight
choices.description: Skull of Slaying: unlimited teleports to Slayer Masters, dungeons, targets in unlocked regions. Choice of 2 Slayer assignments. Choose min or max monster counts. Free prefer/block list additions. Elite monsters 5x more likely, 5x Slayer XP. Corrupted slayer helmet effect. Monsters captured into ushabtis 100%.

choices.name: Voidwalker
choices.description: Void shards when skilling (clue scrolls + roll from: invention materials, ancient summoning pouches, blessed fire spirit rewards, crystal essence, divination materials, divine geodes, dragon equipment, goldenhawk feathers). Abyssal conduit: unlimited teleports to all jewellery destinations (glory, combat bracelet, delver's anklet, dig site pendant, enlightened amulet, ferocious ring, games necklace, ring of duelling, ring of respawn, ring of slaying, ring of wealth, skills necklace, traveller's necklace).

passives: 20% chance for 12 invention materials from monsters
No killcount for GWD/Heart of Gielinor
No Keys to the Crossing for Magister

choices.name: Crystal Grace
choices.description: Seren's crystal tiara (omni-tiara, unlimited teleports to all runecrafting altars in unlocked regions). Unlocks all Magic spells across all spellbooks. 5% chance for crystal essence (stackable, replaces pure/impure essence). Rune output x3, max level-based multipliers regardless of RC level. Necromancy rituals: Multiply/Attraction/Protection glyphs at 200% without drawing. Speed glyph at 50% (max) without drawing. Light sources and glyphs need no ingredients. Bones/altar offerings give extra XP equivalent to dragon bone.

choices.name: Transmutation
choices.description: Deities' Transmuter: Alchemical Divergence (transmute up to 10 resources to lower tier) and Alchemical Convergence (transmute up to 10 to higher tier). No level requirement. 10 Magic XP per item transmuted. Auto-recast on noted stacks. Toggle to bank noted products. Use resources on transmuter to see outputs.

choices.name: Antiquarian
choices.description: All Archaeology relics available after tutorial. Materials auto-sent to material storage or bank. Monolith: 1,000 energy (3 active relic powers limit unchanged). Archaeology journal acts as free soil screener. Fixate available immediately, no cap. Lore pages 20% more common (stacks with tier 2 passive for 50% total). Collections: 10x Chronotes (replaces tier 1). Restoring artefacts: half materials. Ancient caskets on collection completion. 100% focus on artefact/lore page. Divine geodes while excavating.
clarifications: 10x Chronotes replaces (not stacks with) tier 1 5x bonus
Lore page bonuses stack: 30% (T2 passive) + 20% (Antiquarian) = 50% total

passives: 20% chance for 20 invention materials from monsters
Dungeoneering tokens x5 (from DG and Elite Dungeons)

choices.name: Clue Connoisseur
choices.description: Uri's Briefcase: stores sealed clue scrolls and caskets, teleport to any hidey-hole in unlocked regions. Globetrotter outfit. Globetrotter charges 3x faster. 3x Treasure Trail Points. Extra casket on completion. Minimum clue steps. Max loot rolls from caskets. All hidey-holes act as full. 2x clue scroll chance. NO LIMIT on sealed clue scrolls.

choices.name: Production Master
choices.description: Brooch of the Spirits: unlimited exquisite urns, portable skilling station benefits when worn, spawns Seren spirits/divine blessings/catalysts of alteration/manifested knowledge. Production activities process all items at once. Food never burns. Masterwork items: 1 action to complete. +6 boost to Construction, Cooking, Crafting, Herblore, Fletching, Smithing.

choices.name: Devout
choices.description: Devout Yak Pouch (32 inventory slots, note/unnote items, access bank anywhere). Ethereal storage scroll (repeat last unnote action). Familiar stat boosts give 10 XP in respective skill every 6 seconds (includes invisible boosts). Summoning scrolls not consumed. Familiar spell point costs 10%. Combat familiars: up to 500% more damage at 99 Summoning.
clarifications: Stat boost familiars give 10 XP every 6 seconds in the boosted skill, including invisible boosts

passives: All Seren spells and prayers unlocked

choices.name: Perkfection
choices.description: Inventor's Toolbox: XP capacitor (10x max charges, charges 10x faster). 2 gizmo slots in addition to equipped perks. Unlimited teleports to inventor's workbenches. Toggle: 0% junk chance when disassembling. 10x materials from disassembling. Machines buildable from level 1, run 10x faster. Augmented items and machines consume no charge. Machine capacity x10. Helpful perks trigger 20% more often (doesn't stack with item level 20). Unlocks all dwarven and cave goblin blueprints.

choices.name: Rejuvenated
choices.description: Pick another relic from any previous tier (1–5). This is your flex slot — correct a missed pick or double down on a powerhouse.

passives: Advance Time spell cast without limit

choices.name: Infernal Fire
choices.description: Avernic Star (inventory/pocket): all combat styles trigger Death Mark 100% (instant kill at 20% LP). 5% adrenaline on Death Mark kill. Pocket slot: +18.7 Melee/Ranged/Magic/Necromancy bonus, +15 Prayer bonus.

choices.name: Naragi Edict
choices.description: Sliver of Edicts (activate every 90s, lasts 16.8s): heals 10,000 LP 4 times every 4.2s, boosts combat levels to 255, revives on death. Pocket slot: +300 armour, +14 Melee/Ranged/Magic/Necromancy damage, +1,500 LP, +15 Prayer bonus.

choices.name: Icyenic Faith
choices.description: Tome of the Icyene: +50 Prayer bonus. 0.2% critical strike chance per 1 Prayer bonus. 0.2% base ability damage per 1 Prayer bonus. Protection prayers and deflection curses block 100% damage. Protection prayers act as Soul Split active.

blessing_tiers.name: Tier 1
passives: 50% chance to save runes in combat
50% chance to save ammunition in combat
50% chance to save ectoplasm and Necromancy runes

choices.name: Adrenaline Junkie
choices.description: Max adrenaline +50%. Adrenaline generation +50%.

choices.name: Big Boned
choices.description: Max life points +50%. All damage gains 5% of max LP as bonus damage.

choices.name: Teragard's Aegis
choices.description: Base ability damage +25% of total armour value (defender: 50%, shield: 75%). Health regeneration +2.5% of max LP (defender: 5%, shield: 7.5%).

blessing_tiers.name: Tier 2
passives: Attack range +1 tile for all styles (max 10)

choices.name: Abyssal Cinders
choices.description: On hit: +15% ability damage as bonus. 5% chance to trigger Inferno of Zamorak (100-200% ability damage to single target).

choices.name: Barkscales
choices.description: Incoming damage reduced by 10% of armour value. After 5 reductions, unleash Grasp of Guthix (poison damage 80-120% ability damage in 3x3 area).

choices.name: Striking Light
choices.description: Basic attack damage +40%. Basic attacks unleash Light of Saradomin (9s cooldown, 40-60% ability damage + 250% armour value).

blessing_tiers.name: Tier 3
passives: 75% chance to save runes in combat
75% chance to save ammunition in combat
75% chance to save ectoplasm and Necromancy runes
All movement ability cooldowns reduced to 4.2s
Nature's rune pouch granted (4 rune types, NO saving passive)

choices.name: Avernic Rampage
choices.description: On-attack: 5% chance to activate Avernic Rampage for 7.2s. Abilities and special attacks (except granite maul) use no adrenaline.

choices.name: Eternal Sustenance
choices.description: Food no longer consumed when eaten. No adrenaline loss when eating.

choices.name: Steadfast Will
choices.description: Empowers defensive abilities: Bash (+350-450% armour value damage), Preparation (reduces all ability CDs by 12s), Reflect (100% reflected + 10-15% armour value, hits up to 8 additional targets), Revenge (duration/CD doubled, max 20 stacks).

blessing_tiers.name: God Tier 1
passives: Choose rotation for Araxxor, Barrows: Rise of the Six, and Vorago

choices.name: Demon's Mark
choices.description: Accuracy always calculated using target's weakness.

choices.name: Splash Zone
choices.description: AoE and multi-target attacks deal 30% more damage. AoE abilities deal +5% damage per tile the target occupies.

choices.name: Sacred Fervor
choices.description: Melee, Magic, Ranged, and Necromancy ability and special attack cooldowns reduced by 30%.

choices.name: Havoc Born
choices.description: Damage +20%. Max life points -25%. Armour value -25%.

choices.name: True Equilibrium
choices.description: Per unique Blessing path chosen across T1-T6: +75 ability damage, +50 armour, +500 LP, +5% crit chance, +7.5% crit damage, +5 Prayer bonus. Stacks 1x/2x/3x. SAME path across all tiers = only 1 stack.

choices.name: Higher Power
choices.description: Base ability damage +30%. Lose access to Berserk, Death's Swiftness, Living Death, and Sunshine.

blessing_tiers.name: Tier 5
passives: God books, scriptures, grimoires, scrimshaws no longer use charge

choices.name: Unholy Critual
choices.description: +15% critical strike chance (capped at 50%). Excess crit chance converted to crit damage 1:1. Inferno of Zamorak +50% crit damage. On crit: unleash Inferno of Zamorak.

choices.name: Tearing Thorns
choices.description: DoT abilities last 100% longer. Every 5th DoT hit triggers Grasp of Guthix. Grasp deals +20-30% of max LP. Grasp deals poison damage 80-120% ability damage in 3x3 area.

choices.name: Lord of Light
choices.description: Basic attacks trigger Light of Saradomin 5x at random tiles near target (up to 8 targets within 1 tile, 14.4s cooldown). Light deals +2% damage per Prayer bonus. Light heals 5% of damage dealt.

blessing_tiers.name: Tier 6
passives: 95% chance to save runes in combat
95% chance to save ammunition in combat
95% chance to save ectoplasm and Necromancy runes

choices.name: Perfidious
choices.description: Inferno of Zamorak activation chance x5. Grasp of Guthix activation requirement reduced to 2. Light of Saradomin cooldown reduced to 4.8s.

choices.name: Envenomed
choices.description: Poison damage +50% + 2% per Herblore level. Damaging an enemy disables their poison immunity for 30s.

choices.name: Tempered Heart
choices.description: Generate 6% adrenaline every 1.2 seconds.

choices.name: Chaotic Insight
choices.description: Each combat equipment item counts as 2 additional pieces towards its set effect.

choices.name: Power Archive
choices.description: Automaton Control Bot: stores up to 20 weapon/armour gizmos, granting their effects while wearing augmented equipment. Combat perks in stored gizmos have rank doubled (excluding perks that don't benefit from additional ranks).

choices.name: Genesis Essence
choices.description: Equipped weapons treated as tier 120.

regions.name: Misthalin
auto_quests: A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains
A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen

regions.name: Fremennik Province
auto_quests: Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf

items: Fairy pet (green recolour of Snowflake pet)

edges.description: Endless Harvest auto-banks logs → Superheated auto-burn while WC has fewer logs to burn. Superheated still wins on bonfire rate.
Survivalist double resources feed Superheated's smelting cap of 60 and auto-cook pipeline.
Golden Touch herbs/potions to bank → Divine Druid auto-cleans and converts to unfinished potions.
Animal Wrangler 20× farm animals + Nature's Network instant crops = maximum bean and produce generation.
Superheated generates invention materials on smithing completion → Perkfection 10× disassembly materials and 0% junk.
Divine Druid 5× charms + Thera's Pouch → Devout Yak stores pouches and scrolls; 500% familiar damage at 99.
Voidwalker void shards roll clue scrolls → Clue Connoisseur no limit on sealed clues + min steps + max rolls.
Crystal Grace unlocks all spellbooks + auto-glyphs → Infernal Fire's Death Mark execution amplified by spell access.
Crystal Grace + Icyenic Faith +50 Prayer bonus = +10% crit chance and +10% base ability damage from tome alone.
Transmutation converts resources → Production Master processes ALL items at once with +6 invisible boost.
Antiquarian 10× chronotes + ancient caskets → Perkfection's machines and augmented gear with no charge drain.
Production Master Brooch of Spirits spawns manifested knowledge → Perkfection 4× augmented XP + no charge drain.
Devout Yak bank anywhere + 500% familiar damage → Naragi Edict's 255 combat levels + revive on death = unkillable.
Rejuvenated lets you take Perkfection AND a previous tier relic, bypassing the normal 1-pick limit.
Rejuvenated can double back for Production Master if you need the +6 boost and Brooch of Spirits.
Infernal Fire 5% adrenaline on execute + Adrenaline Junkie +50% generation = snowball adrenaline loop.
Death Mark execute at 20% → Avernic Rampage free adrenaline abilities = chain executions without stopping.
Death Mark 100% proc + Unholy Critual on-crit Inferno of Zamorak = execute triggers massive AoE.
Naragi Edict +1,500 LP + Big Boned +50% max LP = enormous health pool and 5% bonus damage scaling.
Naragi Edict already heals 40k over 16.8s + revives; Eternal Sustenance's infinite food is overkill.
Icyenic Faith +50 Prayer bonus + Teragard's Aegis armour-scaling damage = both scale from Prayer bonus and armour value.
Icyenic +50 Prayer bonus → Lord of Light Light of Saradomin +2% damage per Prayer bonus = +100% Light damage.
Icyenic protection prayers block 100% + Soul Split + Tempered Heart 6% adrenaline/1.2s = infinite sustain.
Perkfection 2 extra gizmo slots + Power Archive 20 stored gizmos with doubled ranks = 22+ gizmo effects active.
Perkfection no charge drain + Genesis Essence T120 weapons = permanent max-tier augmented weapons for free.
+50% adrenaline gen + free adrenaline abilities = never-ending ultimates.
+50% max adrenaline + 6% adrenaline/1.2s = fastest adrenaline build in the game.
Big Boned +50% LP feeds True Equilibrium's +500 LP per stack and 5% max LP damage bonus.
Big Boned +50% LP vs Havoc Born −25% LP = conflicting LP modifiers; pick one identity.
Teragard's Aegis armour-scaling damage + Steadfast Will Bash/Reflect armour scaling = both reward high armour.
Teragard's Aegis +25% armour value damage + Higher Power +30% base damage = multiplicative tank-DPS hybrid.
Abyssal Cinders 5% Inferno chance + Unholy Critual +15% crit + on-crit Inferno = massive proc density.
Abyssal Cinders Inferno trigger + Perfidious ×5 Inferno chance = Inferno of Zamorak procs constantly.
Barkscales Grasp of Guthix on 5 reductions + Tearing Thorns every 5th DoT also triggers Grasp = double Grasp frequency.
Barkscales poison Grasp of Guthix + Envenomed +50% poison + disables immunity = poison build core.
Striking Light basic attack Light of Saradomin + Lord of Light 5× Light triggers = Light of Saradomin machine gun.
Striking Light basic attack focus + Sacred Fervor −30% CDs = more basic attacks, more Lights.
Avernic Rampage free abilities + Perfidious enhanced Inferno/Grasp/Light = free procs without adrenaline cost.
Eternal Sustenance infinite food negates Havoc Born's −25% LP penalty. Glass cannon with no downside.
Steadfast Will defensive toolkit + Higher Power +30% damage = tank that still hits hard.
Splash Zone AoE +30% + Perfidious enhanced procs = every Inferno of Zamorak and Grasp of Guthix hits harder in AoE.
Demon's Mark weakness accuracy + Infernal Fire Death Mark execute = never miss the execute threshold.
True Equilibrium rewards 3 unique paths; Power Archive stores gizmos from all three paths' gear.
Higher Power +30% base damage + Genesis Essence T120 weapons = highest raw ability damage possible.
Higher Power LOSES Berserk, Death's Swiftness, Living Death, Sunshine — these are core for Infernal Fire's burst windows.
Unholy Critual on-crit Inferno + Perfidious ×5 Inferno chance = crits trigger Inferno almost every time.
Tearing Thorns extended DoT + Envenomed +50% poison + disable immunity = the ultimate poison build.
Lord of Light triggers on basic attacks + Tempered Heart 6% adrenaline/1.2s = basics fuel both Light and adrenaline.
Chaotic Insight +2 set pieces per item + Infernal Fire's raw damage = partial Cryptbloom/Elite Tectonic effects at low piece counts.
Power Archive 20 gizmos with doubled ranks + Perkfection 2 extra gizmo slots = 24+ perk effects simultaneously.
Genesis Essence T120 weapons + Higher Power +30% base damage = weapons hit like tier 156 mathematically.
Animal Wrangler's 20× farm animals and BGH no-bait require Anachronia Dino Farm access.
Desert has Pyramid Plunder and Pollnivneach thieving — Golden Touch coins×100 and no-fail pickpocket dominate here.
Morytania has Necromancy ritual sites — Crystal Grace auto-glyphs at 200% + no ingredients = massive Necro XP.
Wilderness has Revenants and high-tier Slayer targets — Assassin's Insight elite 5× spawn + ushabtis 100% shine here.
Fremennik has Artisans' Workshop — Superheated burial sets×3 + 5× ceremonial swords = fastest Smithing XP.
Perkfection's machines and workbenches require Asgarnia for Invention Guild access.
Tirannwn has elite clue steps and Crystal City — Clue Connoisseur globetrotter + no limit excels.
Kandarin has Meilyr recipe dungeon — Divine Druid unlocks ALL Meilyr recipes immediately.
